title: Project Update and Planning Meeting
discussion_points: Sarah reported that the wireframe for the new onboard flow is ready but needs revisions based on design feedback.
The design team's feedback requires three to four days for revisions, with the revised wireframe due by Thursday.
Anas mentioned that the backend team can start working on API endpoints in parallel, estimating a week for completion.
Omar proposed an AI solution for automated meeting minutes, which requires access to Azure speech API and SharePoint templates.
The Q3 budget review is scheduled for next Monday, with all departments required to submit their estimates by Friday.
decisions: Sarah will revise the wireframes and deliver them to developers by Thursday.
Anas's team will start working on the backend API endpoints.
Omar will develop a proof of concept for the AI meeting intelligence agent within two weeks.
Speaker 1 will arrange Azure resources, and Anas will provide SharePoint template access to Omar.

action_items.task: Revise wireframes for new onboard flow
Develop proof of concept for AI meeting intelligence agent
Provision Azure resources for AI project
Provide SharePoint template access to Omar

follow_ups: Ensure all departments submit Q3 budget estimates by Friday.
Monitor progress on wireframe revisions and backend development.
